intro: Qdoba is a Mexican fast-casual chain and one of the closest competitors to Chipotle, where you build your own burrito, bowl, tacos, salad, nachos or quesadilla down the line. Qdoba's big draw is that queso and guacamole are included free on entrees, which usually cost extra elsewhere. You pick a format and a protein, and the price is set by the protein. Below is the full Qdoba menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Qdoba, a build-your-own entree (burrito, bowl, salad, 3 tacos, nachos) is priced by protein: grilled adobo chicken is about $8.40, steak about $9.15, and Impossible plant-based about $9.95, with queso and guacamole included free. A kids meal is about $4.00 and family meals run about $29 to $40.
hot_deal: Free queso and guac, plus Qdoba Rewards: Qdoba's signature perk is that queso and guacamole come free on entrees, unlike most rivals. Qdoba also runs app and loyalty deals and value burrito meal deals through the year. Offers vary, so check the Qdoba app.

faqs.q: Is queso and guacamole free at Qdoba?
faqs.a: Yes. Qdoba's signature perk is that 3-cheese queso and hand-smashed guacamole are included free on entrees like burritos, bowls, tacos and salads, which usually cost extra at other Mexican chains.

faqs.q: How much is a burrito bowl at Qdoba?
faqs.a: A build-your-own bowl is priced by protein: about $8.40 with grilled chicken, $9.15 with steak, brisket or pork, and about $9.95 with plant-based Impossible, with queso and guac included. Prices vary by location.

Qdoba offers grilled adobo chicken, grilled adobo steak, seasoned ground beef, slow-braised pulled pork, smoked beef brisket, plant-based Impossible and veggie, plus seasonal options like Cholula hot and sweet chicken.
Base entree prices are similar, but Qdoba includes queso and guacamole free, while those are paid add-ons at Chipotle. So a loaded order with queso and guac can work out cheaper at Qdoba.

faqs.q: Does Qdoba have a kids menu?
faqs.a: Yes. Kids options like a burrito bowl, quesadilla, nachos or taco are about $4.00 each.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Qdoba?
faqs.a: Favorites include the chicken burrito bowl, the queso burrito, street style chicken tacos, 3-cheese nachos and the Impossible fajita bowl.
